add.event: 尼日利亚成为首个还清巴黎俱乐部债务的非洲国家（约$18 billion减免+约$12 billion现金）
add.evidence: In April 2006, Nigeria became the first African country to fully pay off its debt owed to the Paris Club. This was structured as a debt write off of approximately $18 billion and a cash payment of approximately $12 billion.

add.event: 外债约$5.9 billion、国内N5.6 trillion，总债务$44 billion
add.evidence: In 2012, Nigeria's external debt was an estimated $5.9 billion and N5.6 trillion domestic, putting total debt at $44 billion.
